title: Why VR is finally ready to replace your monitor

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the monitor you use daily could soon be replaced by something more immersive and powerful?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: VR headsets now have 4K resolution, 120Hz refresh rates, and eye-tracking—making them viable for productivity and design.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But immersion without boundaries could blur the line between work and reality, risking mental health and social isolation.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are implementing focus modes, digital well-being tools, and clear on/off signals to manage usage.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where VR workspaces foster collaboration without the need for physical offices or commuting.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of work is not just digital—it’s spatial, and VR is the bridge to that next frontier.

video_cue: A person working in a virtual office, surrounded by holographic colleagues and digital tools.
